question: show invoice totals by month this year
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at,'%Y-%m') ym, ROUND(SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)),0) total FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' AND YEAR(b.created_at)=2026 GROUP BY ym
agent_sql_scrubbed:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, ?) AS ym, ROUND(SUM((bi.price * bi.quantity - COALESCE(bi.discount, 0)) * (1 + COALESCE(bi.tax, 0) / 100)), 0) AS total
FROM bills b
JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id = b.id
WHERE b.type = ? AND YEAR(b.created_at) = 2025
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;
